class.name: SteamPublisherPurchases
class.brief_description: Trusted Steam Wallet checkout, settlement and refund service.
class.description: Resolve with [method SteamPublisher.purchases] and inject [member SteamPublisherSettings.purchase_store]. Await each action for its typed result. All order-changing calls operate only on trusted persisted quotes and exact Steam receipts. The backend must authorize caller access to known order IDs before exposing these functions to a client.

method.name: buyer_info
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseBuyerInfoResult] with the Steam Wallet country, currency, optional region, and reported account status for [param player]. The identity must come from this exact publisher. Uses the configured live or sandbox environment. Read this before quoting a localized price. The game keeps ownership of its catalog, pricing, and eligibility policy.

method.name: begin
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult]. Requires a [SteamIdentity] verified by the same publisher. Atomically prices and reserves the cart under [param checkout_id], then starts Steam authorization. An uncertain previous initialization is queried without automatically repeating the write.

method.name: query
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult] for a known order. Verifies exact Steam payer, transaction, currency and line amounts and persists applicable state changes. An unknown order or invalid receipt returns a typed error.

method.name: finalize
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult]. Requires an exact Steam query to verify approval before claiming and capturing the charge. Durable fulfillment follows a verified success. An uncertain earlier finalization remains in reconciliation and is never blindly repeated.

method.name: reconcile
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseReconciliationResult] for one bounded settlement page from the inclusive Unix UTC cursor. [param max_results] must be from 1 to 1000 and defaults to 1000. A reply larger than 4 MiB fails validation. Applies known receipts and exact item reversals in order. A failing event leaves the original cursor available for replay. A full page whose last timestamp equals the input cursor returns [constant ERR_BUSY].

method.name: refund
method.description: Await a [SteamPurchaseOutcomeResult]. Queries and requests a full refund only for a known fulfilled order and an explicit store policy approval. Reversal requires a confirmed receipt and durable update. Partial Steam-originated reversals are handled by [method reconcile].
